answer: Paired-receipt bond blocks mass fakes: no agent joins alone. Each identity locks 60 and files a paired receipt whose kernel hashes both keys. The pair completes one reef task together. Auditors wander between plots each epoch, re-running samples; a rented twin fails and burns both bonds. At 45 plus a 60 lock each, 1,000 fakes pay 45,000 and lock 60,000 for a 40,000 pool, losing 65,000; one honest agent pays 45 once and keeps its full share.
